bioprojects.title: Colletotrichum sp. cultivar:Banana Genome sequencing

attributes.name: isol_growth_condt
attributes.value: Sample collection was conducted in four commercial Cavendish banana plantations (Musa, AAA) situated in the southern, central, and northern areas of the Uraba subregion in the department of Antioquia, Colombia. A total of 40 clusters of 11 week old Cavendish bananas were sampled at two locations in the packinghouse. The Barcadilla (fruit reception area) and the wash tank (where the fruit is immersed in water with aluminum and ammonium sulfate to remove the latex from the crown). Afterward, the fruit was placed in a humid chamber at 25C with 12 hours of darkness to promote the sporulation of microorganisms in the crowns. The fungi were isolated from 1 cm2 segments of crowns. The segments were then inoculated onto Potato Dextrose Agar (PDA) culture medium, that was supplemented with 150 ppm of Streptomycin Sulfate. The isolates were incubated at a temperature of 25C for six days. After this period, colonies with similar morphology were selected and purified on PDA with Streptomycin.
